summary: Short university road kerb by a bus zone; no parking, no room.

best_section.where: east kerb of Chancellors Place beside the UQ bus shelter

drivers.seclusion: University buildings 11-25 m away, none are homes; campus foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is only a narrow strip next to the lane; no pull-off, bus stop area.
drivers.traffic: Through road with buses, no parked cars along this side.
drivers.convention: No parking convention; a bus zone is signed just up the road.

flags: Bus zone sign about 11 m from the line
sun_shade: Mixed tree shade from the east side, open from the west.
